data.body: Final preflight is green: make lint passed (including Ruff, format, complexity baseline active=66/new=0/increased=0/stale=0, actionlint, and workflow security lint); make typecheck passed across 491 files; generated MCP reference and public TypedDict drift checks passed; git diff --check passed; final make test passed with 11,686 passed, 44 skipped, 256 deselected, and zero failures in 39m39s. Manual five-axis review found no blocking correctness, readability, architecture, security, or performance finding. Local rebar review-code was invoked but the repository config reports verify.enable_code_review is off, so Gerrit LLM-Review remains the independent automated review gate.
